title: Composition With a Polynomial Argument
statement: Let $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be exponential-polynomial, and let $a,d\in\mathbb{N}$. Then the function $n\mapsto T\bigl(a(n+1)^d\bigr)$ is exponential-polynomial.
replaced:
Let $T : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ be exponential-polynomial, i.e.\ $T(n) \le 2^{K(n+1)^k}$
for all $n$ and some constants $K, k \in \mathbb{N}$. Then for all constants
$a, d \in \mathbb{N}$, the function $n \mapsto T\bigl(a(n+1)^d\bigr)$ is also
exponential-polynomial.
